about: A made realm's record on the wire (record.proto, GitHub #13250), taken from what the server answers today: seed the realm, make each call under /api/playtest/realms as its owner, a stranger (a key no player has) or nobody, and the server answers with this status and body; a step with "sql" runs that statement and gets this value (the publish that pins an engine). A key in "vary" is a number the run decides. "message" names the body's message in record.proto (MineLines: the ?as=lines text; Conflict is realm.proto's; ErrorReply is the API's own refusal, proto/openagents/api/v1alpha1/error.proto) and "request" the request's. metaverse-engine/editor/record-goldens.coax reads and writes every body through metaverse-engine/editor/record.coax; coax/web/api/tests/realm_record_checks.coax makes the calls.

realm.seed: INSERT INTO verse.players (id, key_sha256, created_ms) VALUES ('p-record-fixture', encode(sha256(convert_to('record-fixture-player-key-0001', 'UTF8')), 'hex'), 1); INSERT INTO verse.worlds (id, owner_player, created_ms) VALUES ('made-record-fixture', 'p-record-fixture', 1); INSERT INTO verse.made_realms (slug, world, name, style, ground, time, features, tools, made_ms) VALUES ('record-fixture', 'made-record-fixture', 'Record "Fixture"', 'lowpoly', 'grass', 'day', '[{"feature":"trees","count":4}]', '{"fly":false,"jump":true}', 1);
realm.clean: DELETE FROM verse.realm_publications WHERE slug = 'record-fixture'; DELETE FROM verse.realm_revisions WHERE slug = 'record-fixture'; DELETE FROM verse.made_realms WHERE slug = 'record-fixture'; DELETE FROM verse.worlds WHERE id = 'made-record-fixture'; DELETE FROM verse.players WHERE id = 'p-record-fixture';
